title: Entity Selector
text: Select entities, 2 inputs, 5 outputs; {Number of matching streams} determines how many input entity streams the block, {Key entity attribute Name} sets the name of reference attribute, {Matching entity attribute name(s)} sets the name of selected attribute names, {Number of entities source} sets the source to determine the number of entities to be matched, {Number of entities to select}, {Key attribute for number of entities} sets the key attribute name that determines the number of entities to be matched, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of entities present in the block, which have yet and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the outputs the number of entities extracted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of matching streams
params.values: Determine how many input entity streams the block accepts 1 (default) | numerical

params.name: Key entity attribute Name
params.values: Specify name of reference attribute {’ID’} (default) | character vector

params.name: Matching entity attribute name(s)
params.values: Specify name of selected attribute names {’Type’} (default) | character vector

params.name: Number of entities source
params.values: Source to determine the number of entities to be matched Dialog (default) | Attribute

params.name: Number of entities to select
params.values: Number of entities to select from each of the incoming entity streams 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Key attribute for number of entities
params.values: Key attribute name that determines the number of entities to be matched Name (default) | character vector

params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on
